==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*grǫzъ}}, itself possibly deverbal of {{m|sla-pro|*gręzti|t=to sink}}. Compare {{cog|uk|грузь}} and {{cog|pl|grąz}}.

===Pronunciation===

* {{audio|ru|Ru-груз.ogg}}
* {{audio|ru|LL-Q7737 (rus)-Tatiana Kerbush-груз.wav|a=Saint Petersburg}}

===Noun===
{{ru-noun+|adj=грузово́й}}

# [[weight]], [[load]]
#: {{syn|ru|тя́жесть<g:f><t:heavy load>}}

#: {{syn|ru|бре́мя}}
# {{lb|ru|engineering}} [[weight]], [[counterweight]]

#: {{syn|ru|ка́рго<g:n>}}

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*krǫžiti}} or {{af|ru|круг|-и́ть}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|кружи́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-кружить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|кружи́ть|impf|pf=закружи́ть,вскружи́ть}}

# to [[turn]], to [[whirl]], to [[spin]], to [[wheel]] [[around]]
#: {{uxi|ru|[[мете́ль]] '''кру́жит/кружи́т'''|the snowstorm is whirling}}
#: {{uxi|ru|'''кружи́ть''' [[кто-либо|кому́-либо]] [[голова|го́лову]]|to turn someone's head}}
# to [[circle]], to [[go round]], to [[make circles]]
# to [[wander]]
